property_summary: The reference contract's supportsInterface(mutated) equals IAccessControl's interface id or the ERC165 default behavior, so fuzzing any bytes4 interfaceId and short-circuiting super can be checked against the rule 'supportsInterface(u) || supportsInterface(~u) is not constant false and complies with ERC165', but the bug flips the equality so the mutated contract returns true when it should not for IAccessControl's id and false when it should not for non-interface IDs; the simplest invariant broken is that for any interfaceId the reference returns the same boolean at least as often as the bug does when interfaceId equals the IAccessControl interface id (which the mutated version returns false for) while the reference returns true.
change_summary: Negate the IAccessControl interface-id equality check, flippling which interfaceId values return true versus false.
